Committee: Ways and Means Education
Sponsor: Hall
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 03/07/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 445 as introduced would exempt the Rosetta James Foundation from all state, county, and municipal fees and taxes. According to information provided by the Foundation, this bill would decrease sales and use tax receipts to the following funds by the following estimated annual amounts:
Education Trust Fund
($800)
County Funds
($100)
Municipal
($900)
Total
($1,800)
Danny Garrett, Chair
Ways and Means Education
